newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures edge lower after jobless claims.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures edge lower after jobless claims.

text.p: July 24 - U.S. debt futures edged lower after a larger-than-expected drop in jobless claims. Claims in the week ended July 19 fell to 299,000 from a revised 341,000 in the previous week. The forecast had been for a drop to 333,000. Sept T-bond support at 115-2/32 to 114-29/32, traders said.
